3D forecast chart

Interactive 3D chart by Akilan Chithra Sathish (UTD RIDE), built for the HydroTwin Field Lab. X: forecast target date · Y: estimated gauge height (ft) · Z: the selected environmental reading on the earlier issue date. Orange is the forecast, blue is the observed-flow estimate; each line joins forecasts from successive issue dates at the same lead. Both height curves come from this station’s stage–discharge fit — they are estimates, not measured water levels, depth, or absolute elevation. Environmental readings show associations, not causation; soil and snow sensors can be far from the gauge.
